info.name: Enrollment review (Requirements, Approval steps, Applications, Signoffs)
info.description: The Requirements, Approval steps, Applications and Signoffs APIs, plus the approval-enrolls-the-store path. They are switched off by default: start the server with APP__FEATURES__ENROLLMENT_REVIEW=true (or features.enrollment_review = true in config.toml) before running this. See docs/parked-enrollment-review.md.

item.name: The Requirements page is in the catalog
The Applications & Approvals page is in the catalog
Enrollment has its three groups again
A program can select both pages

exec: pm.test('one active enrollment linked to the application',()=>{const e=j.results[0];pm.expect(j.total_size).to.eql(1);pm.expect(e.store_id).to.eql('s1');pm.expect(e.store_name).to.eql('Alpha Store');pm.expect(e.store_resolved).to.eql(true);pm.expect(e.status).to.eql('active');pm.expect(e.application_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('eapp'));pm.expect(e.contracts_count).to.eql(0);});

item.name: Same store, another website is fine
Chip: Submitted shows it with the step name
The store can apply again after a withdrawal
Overview: pending still zero (a draft was never pending)
A waits at step 1 and can be approved or rejected
Approve step 1 as alice (looking at step 1)
A moved on to step 2, in review
A second click that still says step 1 -> 409
Approve step 2 as bob (the last step)
A is approved: no step, no actions, decided
Overview: A approved, two still pending
B is rejected: no step, no actions
A step that has signoffs cannot be removed -> 409
List signoffs of A: two, in order

exec: pm.test('the final approval has before and after',()=>{const e=j.results.find(e=>e.action==='approved'&&e.target_type==='application');pm.expect(e.before.status).to.eql('in_review');pm.expect(e.after.status).to.eql('approved');pm.expect(e.after.decision).to.eql('approved');pm.expect(e.actor).to.eql('bob');});

item.name: Client id that is not a UUID -> 400
Reorder with an id of another program -> 404

exec: // Self-contained: if this folder is run on its own, create the program (and one item) it needs.
const base = pm.collectionVariables.get('base_url'); const slug = 'rqn-' + Date.now();
const post = (url, body, cb) => pm.sendRequest({url: base + url, method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body)}}, cb);
post('/programs', {name: 'Negative checks', slug: slug, level: 'location', modules: []}, (e, r) => {

post('/programs/' + slug + '/requirements', {type: 'signup', name: 'Sign up'}, (e2, r2) => { if (e2 || r2.code !== 200) return; pm.collectionVariables.set('rid1', r2.json().id); pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/programs/' + slug}, (e3, r3) => { if (!e3) pm.collectionVariables.set('rver', r3.json().config_version); }); });

item.name: An application with no approval step -> 400
The Actions column says it can only be withdrawn
List signoffs: application of another program -> 404
List signoffs of a rejected application
Nothing above decided the pending one

exec: // Self-contained: if this folder is run on its own, build what it needs:
// program 1 (one approval step) with a draft, a pending and a rejected application; program 2 (no approval steps) with a submitted one.
const base = pm.collectionVariables.get('base_url'); const stamp = Date.now();

const post = (url, body) => new Promise(res => pm.sendRequest({url: base + url, method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body || {})}}, (e, r) => res(e ? null : r)));
const id = r => (r && r.code === 200) ? r.json().id : null;
await post('/programs', {name: 'Signoff negatives', slug: s1, level: 'location', modules: []});
const step = id(await post('/programs/' + s1 + '/approval-steps', {name: 'Only step', approver_role: 'admin'}));
const draft = id(await post('/programs/' + s1 + '/applications', {store_id: 'h-draft', website_id: 'w'}));
const pend = id(await post('/programs/' + s1 + '/applications', {store_id: 'h-pend', website_id: 'w'}));
const rej = id(await post('/programs/' + s1 + '/applications', {store_id: 'h-rej', website_id: 'w'}));
await post('/programs', {name: 'No steps', slug: s2, level: 'location', modules: []});
const noapp = id(await post('/programs/' + s2 + '/applications', {store_id: 'h-no', website_id: 'w'}));
Object.entries({hslug: s1, hstep: step, hdraft: draft, hpend: pend, hrej: rej, hnoslug: s2, hnoapp: noapp}).forEach(([k, v]) => v && pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v));
